motorDiagnostics: none — `make` printed zero motor warnings (grep -c 'motor warning' make.log.txt = 0); the emptied list is the bake's encoding of 'no diagnostics'

cueBand.staging: receiver staged at entrance center (x 0.5 = 960, ground 0.602 = 650, scale 0.88); server at the default right lane (x 0.65 = 1246, 0.602, scale 0.88); the two stand 288 px apart
cueBand.missingAt: cues at 0.770 s and later are named misses: 'strike missed: receiver never touched shuttle; a struck contact needs the prop inside the 137 px arm envelope — stage it held or in flight, not on the floor'
cueBand.directionFlip: inside the band the return's direction flips: cues up to ~0.700 s meet the shuttle right of the receiver and return it right (toward the server's side); cues 0.700-0.750 meet it left of the receiver and return it left. The chosen 0.570 returns it right.

camera: camera.follow(receiver, {sec: 2.2, zoom: 0.75}) from the serve cue (0.55 s): the frame is 1707 x 960 world px on the receiver, the frame top stays at world y 0, so no drawn head is sliced in any frame (the head tops are at world y 50)
cleanState: episodes/a-rally/dist/ is a build output of this package and is deleted before hand-off; episodes/*/dist/*.mp4 is NOT ignored by .gitignore (a negation un-ignores it), so it must not be staged
